verdict.label: benign
verdict.description: Postinstall script validates native bindings and installs @swc/wasm as fallback.

behaviors.behavior: Reads package.json to identify target package name
behaviors.analysis: Script reads package.json via path.resolve(process.env.INIT_CWD, 'package.json') to determine if it's @swc/core or @swc/workspace.
behaviors.impact: Legitimate dependency resolution for optional native bindings.

behaviors.behavior: Executes npm install command to install @swc/wasm fallback
behaviors.analysis: Executes npm install with specific flags to install @swc/wasm as a fallback when native bindings are missing.
behaviors.impact: Ensures functionality by installing required wasm module if native binary fails.

behaviors.behavior: Removes temporary installation directory after use
behaviors.analysis: Uses removeRecursive function to clean up temporary npm-install directory after installation.
behaviors.impact: Prevents accumulation of temporary files during postinstall process.
